title: How noisy is a wind farm?
summary: A two-minute Telegraph report that takes a decibel meter to a wind farm and nearby residential areas to measure how loud turbines are compared with everyday noise.
why: HN cites it in wind-power debates as measured evidence that turbine noise is low relative to ambient or road noise.

quote.text: Unless you're within 200m of a turbine, the background ambient sounds are louder than the sound of the turbine.
